dictionary_details.title: Noetikon - k7m Template

label_notes.entry_title: The title of the K7 Mix, such as "Summer Hits" or "Bangers".
label_notes.description: Prefer at most 500 characters (soft limit; longer values are accepted). Brief description or presentation, printed on the other side of the cover image. Example: "These are the tracks I listened to during my trip to Japan. Each carried fond memories of a beautiful place."
label_notes.url: Optional. A link to associate with the file, which could be anything. A Spotify playlist link, for example. If this field is filled-in with a valid link, a QR code to it is printed alongside the description text in the inner cover.
label_notes.datapoint_6: Example: "none, crossfade 5s, crossfade 10s, none, crossfade 5s, silence 1s, crossfade 10s, silence 2s".

dictionary_details.notes: An example of what a k7m dictionary might look like. Just a draft at the moment. The tracks themselves are files in the folder where this exported dictionary is placed, with their order as the filename, such as "01 - Deep forest.mp3", "02 - Swamp.wav", "03 - Savanna.midi" and so on.  So track order is not determined in this dictionary.

entries.description: The greats summer bangers of all time, music to listen to on the beach.
